title: terminalia chicharronia subsp. domingensis
intro: Terminalia chicharronia subsp. domingensis, commonly known as Dominican Terminalia, is a plant species belonging to the family Combretaceae, native to the Dominican Republic and Haiti. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Terminalia chicharronia subsp. domingensis include anti-diarrheal, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may help in the management of digestive issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
